categories.rationale: Fixes a silent failure during script decompression that could allow corrupted data to turn unspendable scripts into anyone-can-spend scripts. As noted in the description, `ScriptCompression::Unser` previously ignored the return value of `DecompressScript`, leaving the script empty on failure rather than raising an error.
